reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 This is a survey of RL-based LLMs and wireless-network synergy. It discusses resource/edge deployment themes but does not present a specific inference serving method or new cost/latency evaluation relevant to the linked routing family.
title: DeepSeek-Inspired Exploration of RL-Based LLMs and Synergy with Wireless Networks: A Survey
